fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.architectures

Class CoupledModelDescriptor

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.architectures.CoupledModelDescriptor
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ModelDescriptorI, java.io.Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    CoupledHIOA_Descriptor, RTCoupledModelDescriptor

    public class CoupledModelDescriptor
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable, ModelDescriptorI
    The class CoupledModelDescriptor defines coupled models in simulation architectures, associating their URI, their static information, as well as an optional factory that can be used to instantiate a coupled model object to run simulations.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       modelClass != null || cmFactory != null
 invariant       modelURI != null && !modelURI.isEmpty()
 invariant       submodelURIs != null && submodelURIs.size() > 1
 invariant       submodelURIs.stream().allMatch(uri -> uri != null && !uri.isEmpty())
 invariant       imported != null
 invariant       imported.values().stream().allMatch(ess -> Stream.of(ess).allMatch(es -> submodelURIs.contains(es.importingModelURI)))
 invariant       reexported != null
 invariant       reexported.values().stream().allMatch(re -> submodelURIs.contains(re.exportingModelURI))
 invariant       connections != null
 invariant       connections.keySet().stream().allMatch(es -> submodelURIs.contains(es.exportingModelURI))
 invariant       connections.values().stream().allMatch(ess -> Stream.of(ess).allMatch(es -> submodelURIs.contains(es.importingModelURI)))
 invariant       connections.entrySet().stream().allMatch(e -> Stream.of(e.getValue()).allMatch(es -> es.sourceEventType.isAssignableFrom(e.getKey().sinkEventType)))
 invariant       mc != null

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

      • checkArchitecturalConsistency

        public boolean checkArchitecturalConsistency(java.util.Map<java.lang.String,AbstractAtomicModelDescriptor> atomicModelDescriptors,
                                             java.util.Map<java.lang.String,CoupledModelDescriptor> coupledModelDescriptors)
        check both the consistency of the coupled model in the context of a complete architecture i.e., when information about the submodels are known.

        Description

        This method checks the following conditions:

        1. Every submodel is defined either as atomic or as coupled model in the architecture:

          submodelURIs.stream().allMatch(uri -> atomicModelDescriptors.containsKey(uri) || coupledModelDescriptors.containsKey(uri))

        2. Every imported event correspond to an existing submodel consuming it:

          imported.values().stream().allMatch( sinks -> Stream.of(sinks).allMatch( sink -> CoupledModelDescriptor. isSubmodelImportingEventType( sink.importingModelURI, sink.sinkEventType, atomicModelDescriptors, coupledModelDescriptors)))

        3. Every reexported event correspond to an existing submodel producing it:

          reexported.values().stream().allMatch( re -> CoupledModelDescriptor. isSubmodelExportingEventType( re.exportingModelURI, re.sourceEventType, atomicModelDescriptors, coupledModelDescriptors))

        4. All connections are among existing submodels that export and import the corresponding events:

          connections.entrySet().stream().allMatch( e -> CoupledModelDescriptor.isSubmodelExportingEventType( e.getKey().exportingModelURI, e.getKey().sourceEventType, atomicModelDescriptors, coupledModelDescriptors) && Stream.of(e.getValue()).allMatch( es -> !es.importingModelURI.equals( e.getKey().exportingModelURI) && CoupledModelDescriptor. isSubmodelImportingEventType( es.importingModelURI, es.sinkEventType, atomicModelDescriptors, coupledModelDescriptors)))

        Contract

         pre     atomicModelDescriptors != null
 pre     coupledModelDescriptors != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        atomicModelDescriptors - descriptors of the atomic models including the ones that are submodels.
        coupledModelDescriptors - descriptors of the coupled models including the ones that are submodels.
        Returns:
        true if the descriptor satisfies the consistency constraints.
